name: devspec-markdown
description: DevSpec Markdown monorepo: reusable core renderer, CLI, and VS Code extension.

scripts.compile: npm run compile -w @devspec-markdown/core && npm run compile -w @devspec-markdown/cli && npm run compile -w devspec-markdown-vscode
scripts.sample:html: npm run devspec -w @devspec-markdown/cli -- build --input docs/templates/sample-devspec.md --output build/sample-devspec.html
scripts.sample:pdf: npm run devspec -w @devspec-markdown/cli -- pdf --input build/sample-devspec.html --output build/sample-devspec.pdf --browser "C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe"
scripts.package:vsix: npm run compile && npm run prepare:vsix
